    Personal Statement

    I pursue data-driven strategy formulation by fusing engineering systems thinking with the econometric analytical skills honed in my master’s program. During my undergraduate studies, I built a foundation in energy systems. At Waseda University’s graduate program, I focused on mathematical modeling for policy prediction using large-scale data with Python and Stata.

    In parallel with this academic training, at Apple Japan I serve as a Technical Expert, leading team performance analysis and mentoring in a multilingual and diverse environment. I am passionate about the process of identifying team challenges from concrete data and maximizing outcomes.

    Currently, I am advancing toward CFA Level I certification to further integrate financial analysis at a higher level. Leveraging my strengths in advanced quantitative analysis and global leadership, I aim to contribute as an immediate force in solving complex business challenges.

    Technical Skills

    • Programming: Python, Stata
    • Data Analysis: Econometric modeling, large-scale data processing, policy prediction
    • Engineering: Applied Chemistry, energy systems
    • Finance: CFA Level I (in progress)
    • Languages: Japanese (N1), English (TOEIC 960 / TOEFL iBT 113), Russian (Level 1)
